outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic/diagram illustrating camera exposure time vs illumination-overhead segments with calculated percentages for each condition; it is not a plot of averaged replicate data, so individual data points do not apply.

This is a line plot of photobleaching decay curves (mean of three experiments) with shaded s.e.m. bands. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make them unreadable.

Each colored point represents the mean ± s.e.m. of ΔROS across three independent experiments for a given light condition. Unlike a true scatter plot where dots are raw measurements, these dots are group averages, and no individual experiment values are overlaid to show the underlying spread.
Each line already represents a single migrating cell's raw track; the panel shows individual data (not an averaged summary), so overlaying additional points is not applicable.
Bar chart of mean±s.e.m. migration speed with individual cell data points (black dots) overlaid on each bar.
Panel F consists of fluorescence micrographs (Mitotracker/Paxillin/Merge) rather than a quantitative plot of averages, so the check does not apply.
Panel G shows a time-lapse series of micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel H shows a time-lapse series of micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Line plot of normalized cell area over time (mean±s.e.m., n=5). Line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time (mean±s.e.m., n=5). Line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
